links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity at the pre-defined cut-point versus the locally optimal cut-point (Youden) for DR and AMD
links.effect: For AMD at the pre-defined cut-point, sensitivity was 88.9% and specificity 66.7%. The optimal cut-point of 52.6 gave sensitivity 87.0% and specificity 75.0%. For DR, the optimal cut-point of 41.2 gave sensitivity 93.7% versus 86.1% at the pre-defined cut-point.
links.quote: At the pre-defined cut-point sensitivity was 88.9% (77.8%-94.8%) and specificity was 66.7% (56.8%-75.3%).

screen.reason: This is an external validation of an existing commercial deep-learning tool (RetCAD) on retrospective clinical data from rural clinics to evaluate diagnostic performance (AUC, sensitivity, specificity) without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
